summary: SVG donut chart with the total in the center, a legend with values and percentages, keyboard navigation between slices, and an accessible data table.
whenToUse: Showing the shares of a single total with few parts (ideally 2–6).
Dashboard summaries where the total matters as much as the breakdown.
whenNotToUse: Comparing similar values or many categories: use BarChart (lengths are easier to compare than angles).
Negative values or values that don't add up to a meaningful total.

props.name: data
props.description: Slices clockwise from 12 o'clock; negative values count as 0.

props.name: title
props.description: Visible title (figcaption); names the chart and the data table.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Format of the values and the total in the current locale; percentages always use Intl with style percent.

props.name: size
props.description: Maximum diameter in px; the chart shrinks with its container.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Label below the total and in the total row of the table.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Legend with the value and percentage of each slice.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Visual style: vivid uses gradients, rounded shapes, and glows with the same theme colors; auto becomes vivid in the expressive look.

inherits: HTML attributes of <figure> (id, style, data-*, aria-*…); the ref points to the <figure>.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the chart area, then to the table button.
Next/previous slice (wraps around): highlights the slice and announces its label, value, and percentage.

accessibility: <figure> with <figcaption>; focusable role="group" area with a hint and aria-live="polite" announcements.
Slices are distinguishable without color (distinct textures repeated in the legend), and the legend always shows values and percentages as text.
Data table with a "Value" column and a total row.
In forced-colors mode, slices become Canvas with a CanvasText border and texture; the active slice has a Highlight border.
responsive: SVG with viewBox: scales up to size px while preserving its aspect ratio.
Entry animation only with prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.
customization: Vivid appearance: appearance="vivid" (or the expressive look) paints with gradients between --dc-color-data-N and --dc-color-accent-default; it falls back to flat in forced-colors mode.
commonMistakes: Using more than 6 slices: colors repeat and angles become unreadable; group minor items into "Other".
Showing only percentages without the total.

examples.name: Vivid
examples.title: Vivid appearance
examples.description: Gradients and glows with the theme colors.

limits: No labels on slices: values are in the legend, the active readout, and the table.
Beyond 6 slices, colors and textures repeat.
